title: Longest Target-Sum Subarray
summary: Return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray summing to target.
statement: Return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray summing to target. Implement `longest_target_sum_subarray` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: The earliest matching prefix produces the longest ending subarray.
Store each prefix only on first occurrence and compare against prefix-target.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the longest_target_sum_subarray invariant is complete.
Editorial: Store each prefix only on first occurrence and compare against prefix-target. The intended bounds are O(n) time and O(n) space.
